column1: # Rows db.x7.* (line RG item X7-1, 2026-11-27): PSIBLAST against a database sequence whose Seq-align id (or display id) NCBI's scope finds as a query of its batch by a generated id (lcl|Query_N of a query read without -parse_deflines, or a PSSM query's local id): LOSAT refuses each format that shows the query in its place (report::query_bioseq::FoundWriters; the Seq-annots, the archive, SAM, tables of fields that read nothing of it, or only letters and a length that are its own where the found query has them over the HSPs (report::query_bioseq::compare_found, fix round 2), and the organism report of a sequence without a taxid, or without a taxonomy database, are NCBI's bytes). Probes X/xt/x7/x71/probe2 of line RG. Fix round 3 (review 2 of X7-1, 2026-11-28): the found query's own id refuses unless the sequence's id spells it byte for byte (NCBI's scope finds lcl|query_1 as Query_1), TBLASTN's sstrand refuses (N/A at NCBI), and TBLASTN's and TBLASTX's frames of a minus-strand HSP refuse where the found query's length is not the sequence's; an X is a letter as any other; the refusal comes after the reports NCBI writes before it (the batches before, the documents' start, psiblast's round report before its next PSSM: `ncbi-first`). Rows on the r3* fixtures of tests/db_search/x7r; probe X/xt/x7/x71/fix3/p5 of line RG.
